[b]I Am Hosting An "Ask Me Anything" and A "Help Desk" Session On My Discord Server.[/b] Here I Would Like To Know About Your Experiences With My Game, As I Am Still Developing And Learning New Problems Daily （＾∀＾●）ﾉｼ. I Understand Some Users Are Experiencing Things That I Didn't Expect, Many Things That Were Not Prevalent To Me or My PC During My Playtesting. Which Is Why I Wanted To Upload This Demo. As A Solo Dev I Am Curious As To See What These Issues Are, And Hope I Can Fix Them Or Understand Them For Future Builds Of This Game. This Of Course Is A Passion Project, And I Am Willing To Work On Things Until The End.
